title: Resume a stopped landing without inventing success
when: When a landing notice reports a stopped queue, failed check or unavailable automatic wake.
need: Identify the actual check/protection/ownership problem and the supported same-item recovery; a green check is not itself a merge receipt. Standalone close-out waits only for push-owned checks. A cancelled push follows a proven descendant with replacement push workflows, reports the superseding SHA and retains the original deadline. Merge receipts keep the item's own landing identity when another target push arrives before close-out.
surface: Landing notice, holder/steering recovery and governed merge re-entry
gap: A recovery guide exists. Review question: do each harness notice and FIRST-USER 35 output link the correct recovery without implying universal automatic desktop wake?
